acceptance.printed_types:
@CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.validate_sound : ∀ {n : ℕ} (bytes : ByteArray)
  (cols : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.Columns n),
  CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.validateFragment n bytes = some cols →
    (∃ text raw,
        String.fromUTF8? bytes = some text ∧
          Lean.Json.parse text = Except.ok raw ∧
            CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.decodeColumns n raw = some cols ∧
              CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2 (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue cols) =
                raw) ∧
      bytes = CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload cols ∧
        (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.natValues cols).length = n ∧
          ∀ (j : Fin n), CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.columnFunction cols j < 2 ^ n
@CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.validate_complete : ∀ {n : ℕ}
  (cols : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.Columns n),
  CurrentMain.ByteJsonGlobalCall.parseBytes (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload cols) =
      Except.ok
        (CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2 (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue cols)) →
    CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.validateFragment n (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload cols) =
      some cols

@CurrentMain.CompactFragmentDictionary.recoverFragment_sound : ∀ {n : ℕ} (bytes : ByteArray) (dictionary : Lean.Json)
  (key : String) (update coefficients : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n)
  (r : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.CheckedEntry n),
  CurrentMain.CompactFragmentDictionary.recoverFragment n bytes dictionary key update coefficients = some r →
    (∃ text raw,
        String.fromUTF8? bytes = some text ∧
          Lean.Json.parse text = Except.ok raw ∧
            dictionary.getObjVal? key = Except.ok raw ∧
              CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.decodeColumns n raw = some r.columns ∧
                CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2
                    (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue r.columns) =
                  raw) ∧
      bytes = CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload r.columns ∧
        (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.natValues r.columns).length = n ∧
          (∀ (j : Fin n), CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.columnFunction r.columns j < 2 ^ n) ∧
            CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns =
                ↑(CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.checkedEquiv ↑r.certificate ⋯) ∧
              (∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
                  CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate)
                      ((CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns) x) =
                    x) ∧
                ∀ (x : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Address n),
                  (CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.columnOperator r.columns)
                      (CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.inverseAddress (↑r.certificate) x) =
                    x
@CurrentMain.CompactFragmentDictionary.recoverFragment_complete : ∀ {n : ℕ} (dictionary : Lean.Json) (key : String)
  (cols : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.Columns n) (c : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.Candidate n)
  (h : CurrentMain.CheckedBinaryChart.check c = true)
  (hc : c.columns = CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.columnFunction cols),
  CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.dictionaryColumns n dictionary key = some cols →
    CurrentMain.ByteJsonGlobalCall.parseBytes (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload cols) =
        Except.ok
          (CurrentMain.StrictJsonValueBridge.reencode 2 (CurrentMain.ParsedBinaryChartCertificate.vectorValue cols)) →
      CurrentMain.CompactFragmentDictionary.recoverFragment n (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.payload cols)
          dictionary key c.updateVector c.coefficients =
        some { columns := cols, certificate := ⟨c, h⟩, column_match := ⋯ }

CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnAscii.toUTF8_one_byte : ∀ (s : String),
  (∀ c ∈ s.data, c.val ≤ 127) → s.toUTF8.data.toList = List.map (fun c => c.val.toUInt8) s.data
@CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnAscii.validate_representation : ∀ {n : ℕ} (bytes : ByteArray)
  (cols : CurrentMain.JsonPackedColumnDictionary.Columns n),
  CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.validateFragment n bytes = some cols →
    bytes.data.toList =
        List.map (fun c => c.val.toUInt8)
          (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.natArrayText
              (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.natValues cols)).data ∧
      ∀
        c ∈
          (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.natArrayText
              (CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnFragment.natValues cols)).data,
        CurrentMain.CompactNatColumnAscii.Allowed c

scope.fragment: Actual UTF-8/JSON parsing, strict ordered bounded-column decoding and complete byte equality derive the original parser/AST equations and exact compact payload; completeness retains the exact parser round-trip premise.
scope.dictionary_join: Actual fragment validation and unchanged restricted recovery precede full ordered column-list comparison. Success derives identical parsed fragment and named AST, exact compact bytes and the independently defined binary operator with both inverse laws.
scope.ascii: For arbitrary Nat lists, logical Nat.repr has only decimal digits and compact arrays add brackets/commas. Generic ASCII strings use exactly one UTF-8 byte per character in order; actual fragment validation transfers this representation to the original bytes.
scope.dimensions: All natural dimensions, including zero; arbitrary Nat magnitudes in the encoding/alphabet statements. Restricted one-transvection-after-permutation recovery is retained. Invertibility alone is not a completeness criterion.
not_established: A generic theorem that actual Lean.Json.parse succeeds on every compact encoding; its equation remains explicit in completeness.
Equivalence to every Python/Lean serializer, numeric-value parser correctness, lexical normalization or duplicate-key policy.
Physical substring membership in dictionary-file bytes, file provenance, digest/key authenticity or actual selected-file validation success.
General binary matrix recovery, complex phases, physical chart direction/execution, resource bounds or the full multiplication theorem.
Correctness of runtime extern implementations is distinct from the logical representation theorems.
